title: chore: allow pollinations-router community publishing
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `pollinations-router`’s immutable GitHub user ID to the community-model publisher allowlist.
- Keeps the allowlist stable if the GitHub username changes.

Checks:
- `npx biome check --write shared/auth/github-id-list.ts`
- Direct allowlist membership and uniqueness assertion via Node

gist.headline: Router joins the garden
gist.blurb: The pollinations-router account has been given a permanent plot in the community-model garden. Its GitHub ID stays recognized even if the username decides to molt.
gist.summary: Added pollinations-router’s immutable GitHub user ID to the community-model publisher allowlist, so it can publish community models without depending on a mutable username.
gist.impact: Community model publishing now recognizes pollinations-router reliably even if its GitHub username changes.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli welcoming a small friendly router-shaped companion through a garden gate labeled COMMUNITY MODELS, with an ID badge as the stable identity symbol. Include code-plants and a tiny GitHub-style octocat-shaped badge without relying on a username, emphasizing durable access to the shared garden.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot wearing a tiny gardener scarf, welcoming a friendly little retro router with blinking lights through a lime green (#ecf874) garden gate labeled “COMMUNITY MODELS”; the router carries a sturdy pixel ID badge while code-plants bloom around it. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, dark purple (#110518) outlines, emotionally warm and welcoming.
